Chhattisgarh Patwaris Given Ultimatum to End Strike or Face Action

In Chhattisgarh, striking patwaris (village revenue officers) have been issued a final ultimatum by the administration to return to work immediately. Failure to comply will result in disciplinary action, including a potential service break. The administration has issued notices to 819 employees across 6 districts. This action follows an ongoing strike by the patwaris.
